name: es30-texture-3d-and-arrays
title: 3D textures and 2D array textures
summary: sampler3D and sampler2DArray on a contact sheet of 58 panels: NEAREST and LINEAR filtering across slices of a 3D texture, wrapping of the r coordinate, rounding and clamping of the array layer coordinate, texelFetch and textureSize, glTexSubImage3D / glCopyTexSubImage3D, UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT and UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES, and rendering into one slice or layer with glFramebufferTextureLayer, all compared with a CPU model of the sampling equations.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.7.1 Pixel Storage Modes (Table 3.1), §3.7.2 Transfer of Pixel Rectangles (3.7.2.1 Unpacking, UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH/ALIGNMENT)
ES 3.0 §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (TexImage3D/2D, UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT, UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES, size limits; ES 3.2 §8.5 for the INVALID_ENUM target error)
ES 3.0 §3.8.5 Alternate Texture Image Specification Commands (TexSubImage3D, CopyTexSubImage3D and their INVALID_VALUE conditions)

ES 3.0 §3.8.10 Texture Minification (3.8.10.1 equation 3.19, 3.8.10.2 Coordinate Wrapping and Texel Selection: Table 3.22, equation 3.22 trilinear filter, array layer l = clamp(RNE(r), 0, dt-1) and its footnote), §3.8.11 Texture Magnification
ES 3.0 §3.8.13 Texture Completeness (default NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR needs a mip chain), §3.8.14 Texture State (initial WRAP_R = REPEAT)

ES 3.0 §4.4.2.4 Attaching Texture Images to a Framebuffer (FramebufferTextureLayer, FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_TEXTURE_LAYER), §4.4.4.1 Framebuffer Attachment Completeness (layer < depth), §4.4.3.1 Rendering Feedback Loops
ES 3.0 §2.1 (commands are processed in order), §2.12.9.3 Texture Size Query, Table 6.28 (MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE, MAX_ARRAY_TEXTURE_LAYERS >= 256)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers (no default for sampler3D / sampler2DArray), §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (texture, textureSize, texelFetch)

api.glTexImage3D: TEXTURE_3D and TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY levels from client memory and from nullptr (mip levels of the textureSize probes, 1x1xN limit textures); sampled and read back; errors: depth/width/layers over the maximum, negative depth, border 1 (INVALID_VALUE), target TEXTURE_2D (INVALID_ENUM)
api.glTexSubImage3D: a 2x2x2 box and a whole 4x4x1 slice written into a gray 3D texture (sampled and compared texel by texel); UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT/SKIP_IMAGES upload into an existing texture; out-of-range zoffset/depth and negative xoffset -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glCopyTexSubImage3D: a 4x3 rectangle of a framebuffer copied into slice 2 of a 3D texture and a 3x4 rectangle into layer 1 of an array texture (sampled and read back exactly, neighbouring slices unchanged); zoffset == depth -> INVALID_VALUE; strict copy after scissored clears (XFAIL on zink)
api.glTexImage2D: 8x8 copy-source texture, the 4x4 texture whose upload must ignore UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES (read back through a framebuffer), scratch texture for the INVALID_OPERATION case of glFramebufferTextureLayer
api.glFramebufferTextureLayer: slices 1 and 3 of a 3D texture and layers 0 and 2 of an array rendered with a draw call, first and last layer of 1x1xMAX textures cleared (sampled and read back through glReadPixels, unattached layers keep their gray); OBJECT_TYPE/NAME/LEVEL/TEXTURE_LAYER queried; errors: 2D texture (INVALID_OPERATION), layer >= MAX_ARRAY_TEXTURE_LAYERS / MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE, negative layer, level 40 (INVALID_VALUE), default framebuffer bound (INVALID_OPERATION); a nonexistent layer makes the framebuffer INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: color attachment of the 8x8 copy-source framebuffer and of the readback of the glTexImage2D/SKIP_IMAGES texture (framebuffer complete, texels equal)
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE for every layer attachment used; INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT for layer 4 of a 4-layer array and slice 4 of a 4-deep 3D texture
api.glGetFramebufferAttachmentParameteriv: FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_OBJECT_TYPE (TEXTURE), OBJECT_NAME, TEXTURE_LEVEL (0) and TEXTURE_LAYER (3 for a 3D texture, 2 for an array)
api.glPixelStorei: UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT 6 / 0 and UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES 1 / 2 select the sub-volume of client memory (texels compared with a CPU unpack); negative values -> INVALID_VALUE and the state is unchanged
api.glGetIntegerv: UNPACK_IMAGE_HEIGHT and UNPACK_SKIP_IMAGES (initial 0 and as set), MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE and MAX_ARRAY_TEXTURE_LAYERS (>= 256 and used to size the largest textures), TEXTURE_BINDING_3D and TEXTURE_BINDING_2D_ARRAY
api.glTexParameteri: MIN/MAG filter NEAREST or LINEAR, WRAP_S/T CLAMP_TO_EDGE and WRAP_R REPEAT / MIRRORED_REPEAT / CLAMP_TO_EDGE of every panel (observed through the sampled colors); WRAP_R read back
api.glGetTexParameteriv: TEXTURE_WRAP_R of a 3D texture: initial REPEAT, then MIRRORED_REPEAT as set
api.glGenTextures: all texture objects of the demo
api.glBindTexture: TEXTURE_3D on unit 0 and TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY on unit 1 per panel; the two bindings are independent (queried)
api.glActiveTexture: unit 0 for the sampler3D, unit 1 for the sampler2DArray
api.glBindFramebuffer: layer rendering, readback and READ_FRAMEBUFFER for glCopyTexSubImage3D
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the whole contact sheet and of every attached slice/layer, compared with the CPU model
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quad per panel and per rendered layer
api.glViewport: per-panel viewport maps the quad to the panel; 16x16 / 8x8 viewports for the render targets
api.glClearColor: background; first/last layer colors of the 1x1xMAX textures; scissored clears in the zink check
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT: contact sheet background, layers of the 1x1xMAX textures
api.glScissor: rectangles of the scissored clears of the copy-after-clear check
api.glGetUniformLocation: sampler, mode, r, index, lod, base, gx, gy and size uniforms located
api.glUniform1i: sampler uniforms hold texture UNIT indices (0 and 1); u_mode, u_index and u_lod select what a panel reads
api.glUniform1f: u_r: normalized depth coordinate of a 3D lookup or layer coordinate of an array lookup
api.glUniform3f: u_base, u_gx, u_gy of the pattern drawn into slices and layers

visual_review.notes: radeonsi es-max capture viewed at 3x and each pair of rows at 4x (llvmpipe and zink captures differ by at most 1/255 per channel). Bottom row (panels 0-7): hard 4x4 tile grids for the NEAREST panels (slices 1 and 3; REPEAT/MIRRORED/CLAMP give three different slices), smooth blends for the three LINEAR panels. Second row (arrays): hard tiles for the NEAREST layers and smooth tiles for the LINEAR ones, each showing one layer's colors with no mixing of layers. Third row: exact texelFetch tiles for slice 2 and layer 3; the glTexSubImage3D results as gray panels with a 2x2 box in two of them and a yellow/blue checkerboard slice; two untouched gray copy panels. Fourth row: the copied rectangles inside gray (3D slice 2: upper three rows, array layer 1: right three columns) next to untouched gray panels, then pixel-store tiles. Fifth row: more pixel-store tiles, then flat textureSize colors (orange-brown, dark brown, nearly black, brown-red). Sixth row: two more flat textureSize colors, four texelFetch level 0/1 panels, a gray slice and a smooth gradient (rendered slice 1). Top rows: gray unattached slices and layers next to smooth gradients (rendered ones), then red and green (first and last layer of the 1xN textures) and six dark background panels that are intentionally unused. Window-size review (claude-opus-5.5): gpu capture at 333x777 viewed: the 8x8 contact sheet now fills the whole surface with non-square (41-42 x 97 pixel) panels in the same order as at 256x256, the tile grids and gradients stretched vertically, six dark unused panels top right; at 1000x200 the panels are wide and flat.
